title: Disable system performance tuning
summary: Turn off the performance tuning service to revert to default system behavior. Use this if you want to stop using tuned profiles or if a profile is causing issues.

steps.explain: Disable the performance tuning service and revert to default system settings.

rollback.explain: Re-enable tuning by applying a profile. You must know the name of the profile you want to restore.

placeholders.name: PROFILE_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the tuning profile to apply

warnings: Disabling tuning reverts to default system resource management, which may affect performance or power consumption.
